verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents a broad Public API covering tasks, attachments, custom fields, custom task types, filtering, views and comments, and publishes an OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the evidence claims UI parity, and many UI surfaces (Whiteboards, Proofing, Automations, Sprints, Brain² agents) have no evidenced API coverage. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, evidenced API coverage for Whiteboards/Proofing/Automations/Docs editing/agents, independent hands-on corroboration of completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Using the ClickUp API, you can create, update, and manage tasks programmatically.
You can create, update, delete, group, sort, and filter views at any level of the ClickUp hierarchy using the API.
The ClickUp API allows you to view, add, and update or delete comments on tasks, Lists, and Chat views.
Upload attachments to tasks using the ClickUp API.
The raw OpenAPI specification for the ClickUp API is available for each version of our Public API.
